functionalGroups.title: Development workflows
functionalGroups.canonical: Use brainstorming for open-ended discovery, sdd-dev-workflow for requirement-to-task planning, and ai-pair-programmer for implementation.
functionalGroups.recommendation: Use app-scanner for multi-application context. sdd-dev-workflow must inspect code and stop at tasks unless implementation is explicitly requested.

functionalGroups.title: Review and test design
functionalGroups.canonical: Use the narrowest review skill matching the request.
functionalGroups.recommendation: Reserve full-review for combined reports and team-cr for meeting preparation.
